summary: Diff adds a basic single-canister Motoko backend with products/customers/orders and a TanStack Router frontend with navbar, dashboard widgets, inventory CRUD for products, order book list, and an A5-styled invoice view with print CSS. However, most BuildRequest business modules (username/password auth, vendors/users management, purchases/sales with payment tracking, ledger, reports, settings-driven UPI config, and PDF download) are missing or only stubbed/placeholder.

missing_requirements.requirement: Username/password login with role-based permissions (Admin/Staff), initial admin (admin001/admin001), persistence across refresh, and admin-only enforcement in UI and backend.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend uses Internet Identity-based authentication (principal/identity) rather than username/password; no evidence of initial admin credentials or password change flow. Backend authorization exists but is principal/permission based, not username/password auth.

missing_requirements.requirement: Vendor management (add/list/delete) and Customer management (add/list/delete) under Register section with backend persistence and authorization.
missing_requirements.reason: Backend defines and stores Customers but no Vendor type/storage/APIs are shown; vendor functionality cannot be confirmed. Customer CRUD UI is not evidenced in shown diffs (CustomersPage content not included), so full AC (search/sort/delete w/ confirmation) cannot be verified.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin-only user management: create users, assign roles/permissions, list users, delete/disable users; disabled users cannot log in; non-admin blocked in UI and backend.
missing_requirements.reason: No username/password user entities are shown, and UsersPage implementation is not included. Backend shows access control mixin usage but no explicit user CRUD endpoints are evidenced in the truncated backend excerpt.

missing_requirements.requirement: Inventory items with item code/name/quantity, edit/delete with safeguards, transaction-level stock-in/stock-out dates, and configurable low-stock threshold.
missing_requirements.reason: Backend Product type lacks item code and transaction history; no purchase/sale transaction records updating inventory with dates. Low-stock threshold is hard-coded in the dashboard widget, not configurable.

missing_requirements.requirement: Purchase entry module with vendor selection, line items, purchase date/cost, increases inventory, list/filter, and atomic persistence.
missing_requirements.reason: Purchase page is explicitly a placeholder indicating backend not implemented; backend excerpt does not show purchase records or atomic inventory adjustments.

missing_requirements.requirement: Sales entry module with customer selection, line items, sale date, selling price, delivery person, payment status (paid/unpaid/partial) with due amounts, and red-highlight pending.
missing_requirements.reason: Sales page is a placeholder. Backend OrderType has a generic status (#pending/#completed/#cancelled) but no paid/unpaid/partial, paid amount/due amount, or delivery person fields.

missing_requirements.requirement: Order Book showing all sold items with qty, delivery person, date, price, filter by date range/customer/payment status, red-highlight pending, backed by persisted sales/order data.
missing_requirements.reason: OrderBookPage lists orders but lacks required columns like delivery person and item quantities per row, and lacks date-range and payment-status filters (only a customer-name search). Payment status model is not evidenced beyond generic order.status.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ledger derived from sales/orders with running totals, final balance, and clearly indicated pending payments.
missing_requirements.reason: Ledger page is a placeholder explicitly stating backend support is not implemented.

missing_requirements.requirement: Dashboard with sales chart, pending payments list (click-through), low-inventory widget, all driven by backend data with correct metrics and empty states.
missing_requirements.reason: Chart and lists exist and load from queries, but key summary cards show hardcoded values (₹0/0). Pending payments are derived from order.status with a comment indicating it is not real payment tracking; low-stock threshold is hard-coded.

missing_requirements.requirement: Invoice creation/rendering in aligned A5 layout including item code/name/qty/date/delivery person/delivered-to customer and exact firm details block as provided.
missing_requirements.reason: A5 print styling and firm header exist, but delivery person field is not evidenced, and items appear based on Product fields (no explicit item code). Firm address differs (uses 'New Delhi - 110080' rather than the specified '-80' string).

missing_requirements.requirement: Download invoice as PDF in A5 with correct filename/dimensions matching screen.
missing_requirements.reason: Download action is stubbed with a toast ('PDF download requires additional setup'); no PDF generation is implemented.

missing_requirements.requirement: Paytm UPI QR for invoices encoding exact total, and admin-only prompt if config missing in Settings.
missing_requirements.reason: Invoice draws a canvas pattern as a placeholder rather than a real QR code, and UPI payee is hard-coded (dharaenterprises@paytm) with no settings-driven configuration or missing-config admin prompt.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin-only Settings section for changing user IDs/passwords and configuring UPI/Paytm QR parameters with persistence.
missing_requirements.reason: Settings route exists but SettingsPage implementation is not shown; no evidence of user credential changes or persisted UPI configuration used by invoice QR generation (current invoice uses hard-coded UPI fields).

missing_requirements.requirement: Reports section: daily/monthly sales summary, profit/loss, tax (GST) reports derived from purchases/sales with GST rates.
missing_requirements.reason: Reports route exists but ReportsPage implementation is not shown; backend excerpt lacks purchase/sale cost records and GST fields needed for these computations.

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity (II) authentication flow used as the primary login mechanism.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly requires a username/password login system (REQ-1). The diff implements II-based identity via AuthClient and treats presence of identity as authentication.

hallucinated_features.description: Secret-token based access-control initialization via URL parameter `caffeineAdminToken` calling `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret`.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested in requirements; BuildRequest specifies initial admin username/password credentials rather than a secret URL token initialization mechanism.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile storage keyed by Principal (name/email/phone) with profile get/save endpoints.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested in requirements; user management requirements are about username/password accounts, roles, and admin CRUD/disable, not principal-based user profile records.

hallucinated_features.description: Orders model with generic statuses (#pending/#completed/#cancelled) and dashboard/payment logic based on `order.status` rather than explicit paid/unpaid/partial payment tracking.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested as a standalone feature; requirements call for sales with explicit payment status and amounts (REQ-7) and ledger derivations (REQ-9). This implementation diverges into a simplified order status system.
